model.foundation: Blender Studio Human Base Meshes v1.4.1, GEO-body_male_realistic
model.adaptation: Original panelled football kits with sleeve ribs, shorts hems and fabric normals; refined athletic anatomy, boot laces/tongues/heel counters, padded glove ridges and eyebrows; 60-bone rig, two detail levels and 35 named clips including compatibility aliases; world-anchored approach footfalls and seeded keeper gestures. Blender 4.5.9 LTS. Model v5: repaired anatomical eye sockets, fitted irises/pupils and brows, scalp-conforming original hair, distinct jaw/cheek/nose presets, skin vertex tones, smooth jersey panels and slimmed boots. No EA asset data. Surface v6: original pigment/roughness/pores face maps, scalp-projected tapered hair locks sharing scalp primitives, cleaned garment shading normals and neck taper. Existing skeleton, motion and contacts retained. Construction v7: authored continuous jersey torso with shared-vertex sleeve bridges, articulated continuous glove fingers and curved palms, tapered brows, restrained chin/cheek sculpt and asymmetric quiff. Existing rig, clips and contact markers retained. Shoulders v8: continuous chest-clavicle-upper-arm sleeve weights so sleeves, cuffs and upper-arm skin follow raised arms. Construction v7 geometry, rig, clips and contact markers retained.
